content.title: Google's New Gemini Model Improves Understanding of Complex Questions
content.caption: Google's new AI model, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, is better at answering complex questions, including those with multiple parts, hard-to-understand typos, or highly specific requests.

slides.heading: Google's New Gemini Model Improves Understanding of Complex Questions
slides.text: Google's new AI model, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, is better at answering complex questions, including those with multiple parts, hard-to-understand typos, or highly specific requests.

slides.heading: Improvements in Understanding
slides.text: The new model can break down questions, address each part, and provide more helpful answers.
